mapper.select: select bic.id, bic.book_id as bookId, bi.book_name as bookName, bic.book_name as bookNameChange, bic.book_intro as bookIntro, bic.cover_url as coverUrl, bic.publish_status as publishStatus, bic.audit_status as auditStatus, ui.nick_name as adminName, bic.update_time as submitTime, bic.audit_time as auditTime, bic.audit_remark as auditRemark, bic.audit_type as auditType from book_info_change bic left join book_info bi on bic.book_id = bi.id left join user_info ui on bic.audit_admin_id = ui.id where bic.author_id = #{authorId} order by bi.update_time desc

select bic.id, bi.book_name as bookName, bic.book_name as bookNameChange, bic.book_intro as bookIntro, bic.cover_url as coverUrl, bic.publish_status as publishStatus, bic.audit_status as auditStatus, bic.audit_type as auditType, bic.audit_remark as auditRemark, bic.audit_time as auditTime, ui.nick_name as auditName from book_info_change bic left join book_info bi on bic.book_id = bi.id left join user_info ui on bic.audit_admin_id = ui.id where bic.id = #{auditId} and bic.author_id = #{authorId}

select bic.id, bic.book_id as bookId, bic.author_id as authorId, ai.author_name as authorName, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, bic.create_time as subTime, bic.audit_type as auditType from book_info_change bic inner join book_info bi on bic.book_id = bi.id inner join author_info ai on bic.author_id = ai.id where bic.audit_type = 2 and bic.audit_status = #{auditStatus} order by bic.create_time

select bic.id, bic.book_id as bookId, bic.book_name as bookName, bic.cover_url as coverUrl, bic.author_id as authorId, ai.author_name as authorName, bic.create_time as subTime from book_info_change bic inner join author_info ai on bic.author_id = ai.id where bic.audit_type = 1 and bic.audit_status = #{auditStatus} order by bic.create_time

select ca.id, ca.chapter_id as chapterId, bi.book_name as bookName, ca.author_id as authorId, ai.author_name as authorName, bc.chapter_name as chapterName, bc.word_count as wordCount, ca.update_time as subTime from chapter_audit ca inner join book_info bi on ca.book_id = bi.id inner join author_info ai on ca.author_id = ai.id inner join book_chapter bc on ca.chapter_id = bc.id where ca.audit_status = #{auditStatus} order by ca.update_time desc

select bic.id, bi.book_name as bookName, ai.author_name as authorName, bic.book_name as bookNameChange, bic.book_intro as bookIntro, bic.cover_url as coverUrl, bic.publish_status as publishStatus, bic.audit_type as auditType, bic.audit_status as auditStatus, bic.audit_remark as auditRemark, bic.audit_time as auditTime, bic.create_time as subTime from book_info_change bic inner join book_info bi on bic.book_id = bi.id inner join author_info ai on bic.author_id = ai.id where bic.id = #{auditId} and bic.book_id = #{bookId} and bic.author_id = #{authorId} and bic.audit_status = #{auditStatus}

select bic.id, bic.book_name as bookName, bic.author_id as authorId, ai.author_name as authorName, ui.nick_name as auditAdminName, bic.book_intro as bookIntro, bic.cover_url as coverUrl, bic.audit_remark as auditRemark, bic.audit_type as auditType, bic.audit_status as auditStatus, bic.create_time as subTime, bic.audit_time as auditTime from book_info_change bic inner join author_info ai on bic.author_id = ai.id left join user_info ui on bic.audit_admin_id = ui.id where bic.id = #{auditId} and bic.audit_status = #{auditStatus} and bic.audit_type = 1
